title: Capitol Federal Financial, Inc.® Announces Annual Stockholders Meeting Date
summary: Capitol Federal Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: CFFN) (the Company) announced today that the annual meeting of stockholders will be held on Tuesday, January 27, 2026. The voting record date will be December 5, 2025. Capitol Federal Financial, Inc. is the holding company for Capitol Federal Savings Bank (the Bank). The Bank has 46 branch locations in Kansas and Missouri, and is one of the largest residential lenders in the State of Kansas. News and other information about the Company can be found at the Banks website, http://www.capfed.com .
